_comment: Single source of truth for bed-allocation bidding cases. Add a case = add a block in `cases`; add/point a participant = one line in `departments`. The loader (rl_gateway/queries.py) derives everything else from here: keyword->resource matching, resource->unit, department->engine AgentKind, and agent-node->department. NOTE: only these THREE departments exist as real agent nodes (there is no ward_agent) -- `icu` fills the engine's `ward` bidder slot via engine_kind (the F-12/§0 decision). `participants` per case is the local driver for who bids; the engine's /use-cases guard (assert_biddable) stays as a backstop. Data-source mappings (WARD_TO_UNIT, bed-status enums) live in assemble.py/trigger.py, not here -- they are tenant read semantics, not case rules.
